input: Find a github repo relating to autonomous agents - autogpt,auto-dev,  and find the sitemap to langgraph.

plan.description: This plan outlines the steps to find a GitHub repository related to autonomous agents such as AutoGPT or Auto-Dev, and subsequently locate the sitemap for LangGraph within that repository or related links.

steps.description: Open a web browser and go to the GitHub website.
steps.result:
I found several GitHub repositories related to AutoGPT:

1. [Auto-GPT by e2b-dev](https://github.com/e2b-dev/Auto-GPT) - An experimental open-source application showcasing the capabilities of the GPT-4 language model.

2. [Auto-GPT by antony0596](https://github.com/antony0596/auto-gpt/blob/master/README.md) - Another repository showcasing the capabilities of GPT-4.

3. [AutoGPT by Significant-Gravitas](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT) - A platform allowing you to create, deploy, and manage continuous AI agents that automate complex workflows.

4. [Auto-GPT by DataBassGit](https://github.com/DataBassGit/Auto-GPT) - Showcasing GPT-4 capabilities.

5. [Auto-GPT by zer0int](https://github.com/zer0int/Auto-GPT) - Another experimental application showcasing GPT-4 capabilities.

You can explore these links to find more information about autonomous agents like AutoGPT. Let me know how you'd like to proceed from here!

2. [Auto-GPT by DataBassGit](https://github.com/DataBassGit/Auto-GPT): An experimental open-source application showcasing the capabilities of the GPT-4 language model.

3. [AutoDev by unit-mesh](https://github.com/unit-mesh/auto-dev): An AI-powered coding assistant with multilingual support, automatic code generation, and debugging tools.

You can explore these repositories for more information on autonomous agents development using AutoGPT or Auto-Dev. If you need further assistance, please let me know!

steps.description: Select the most relevant repository from the search results.
Look through the repository's files and documentation to identify any references or links to LangGraph.

If a direct link or reference to LangGraph is not found in the repository, perform a web search for LangGraph sitemap to find it externally.
